<?php
class Payload199 { public function __construct(public string $tag) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'PAY-', $this->tag, ';'; } }
function shift199() { global $owner, $alias; $owner = null; $alias[0] = 99; $alias[1] = new Payload199('NEW'); echo 'SHIFT;'; return 9; }
class Base199 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments[0], $name . '|' . $arguments[1] . '|' . self::secret() . '|' . self::class . '|' . static::class . '|' . __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public array $snapshot, public string $data) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class Derived199 extends Base199 {}
$owner = new Derived199; $values = [7, new Payload199('OLD')]; $alias =& $values; $child = $owner->MiSsInG($values, shift199()); echo 'RETURN;'; unset($values); echo 'ALIAS;', $alias[0], '|', $alias[1]->tag, ';'; unset($alias); echo 'HELD;', $child->snapshot[0], '|', $child->snapshot[1]->tag, '|', $child->data, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';

<?php
class StaticPayload199 { public function __construct(public string $tag) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'PAY-', $this->tag, ';'; } }
function staticShift199() { global $alias; $alias[0] = 99; $alias[1] = new StaticPayload199('NEW'); echo 'SHIFT-STATIC;'; return 9; }
class StaticBase199 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments[0], $name . '|' . $arguments[1] . '|' . self::secret() . '|' . self::class . '|' . static::class . '|' . __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public array $snapshot, public string $data) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } }
class StaticDerived199 extends StaticBase199 {}
$values = [7, new StaticPayload199('OLD')]; $alias =& $values; $child = StaticDerived199::MiSsInG($values, staticShift199()); echo 'RETURN;'; unset($values); echo 'ALIAS;', $alias[0], '|', $alias[1]->tag, ';'; unset($alias); echo 'HELD;', $child->snapshot[0], '|', $child->snapshot[1]->tag, '|', $child->data, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
